briefings.title: Drupal Core — Threat Intelligence Update
briefings.headline: CVE-2026-132165, an unauthenticated takeover and remote code execution flaw in the Drupal core installer (core/install.php), is on CISA KEV with a federal due date of today, 2026-11-27. A related installer access bypass, CVE-2026-136716, was fixed on 2026-11-25/26, so sites patched only to 10.6.22, 11.3.22 or 11.4.13 need the newer releases.

briefings.title: Browsers & ChromeOS — Threat Intelligence Update
briefings.headline: Public PoC code is now listed for CVE-2026-74936, a WebAssembly use-after-free in Firefox and Thunderbird that Mozilla fixed in August. Google also shipped a ChromeOS / ChromeOS Flex stable update covering about 404 CVEs. Neither source marks any flaw as exploited.

briefings.title: Linux Distributions — Threat Intelligence Update
briefings.headline: Public PoC code is now listed for two critical-rated Linux kernel flaws: CVE-2026-99362 (nfsd out-of-bounds write) and CVE-2026-74586 (SCTP use-after-free). Separately, EPSS for Go net/http flaw CVE-2026-42508 has risen into the top 6%. None is known to be exploited or KEV-listed.

briefings.title: ASUS Control Center Express — Threat Intelligence Update
briefings.headline: Public proof-of-concept code is now listed for CVE-2026-114202, a CVSS 10.0 hard-coded key flaw in ASUS Control Center Express that lets an unauthenticated remote attacker forge an admin token. No exploitation has been reported. Update to v1.7.29 and redeploy agents.
